svg.title: Two sources. One knowledge base.
svg.desc: DEV OneLake Files, not Delta Tables, feed an indexedOneLake source in Azure AI Search on a five-minute ingestion schedule. Separately, the optional fabricOntology source queries the bound Site/Asset ontology at request time without copying rows or building an index. Both feed the Foundry IQ knowledge base. Foundry models provide embeddings and retrieval planning/synthesis. Normal caller-to-Search authentication is separate from Search-to-Fabric delegation: live ontology retrieval needs an end-user Search-audience token in x-ms-query-source-authorization, never a managed-identity substitute. Search's indexer identity is Contributor on DEV only. The Studio agent instead uses native Fabric IQ for live facts. Knowledge is enabled only after physical DEV IDs are verified; an empty ontology map means documents only.

g.text: Indexed guidance and current ontology facts have different data and identity paths.
Model dependencies, not an app-facing agent.
Chat for retrieval planning and synthesis.
Foundry project: its own managed identity.
Studio uses native Fabric IQ for live facts; this Search source has its own user-token contract.
Enable only after physical DEV IDs are verified. An empty ontology map means documents only.
